Never publish releases, tags, images or deployments. The engine alone may retain objects and publish its candidate. Keep the latest upstream improvements. No dependency installation or reconciliation as a verification side effect; use the configured local audits and hosted CI for missing dependencies. npm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false for all pnpm invocations. features.intent: Support trusted custom Installation profiles, explicit Preset seeding, and readable custom starters.
Grant exact Agent access to every accepted Configuration Secret through the regular save workflow.
Preserve native plugin permission and admission across Harness selection and changes.
Give each person an exact configured native OpenClaw role, independent from OCE administration, with admission and revocation.
Prepare native administration on first Agent deployment while keeping exact runtime access authority.
Manage revision-owned Gateway HTTPS egress with exact per-Agent policy, lifecycle withdrawal, and immutable admission.
Support Microsoft Teams alongside Slack, including editor, directory, exact callback ownership and guarded native media.
Support the explicitly enabled embedded Slack and Teams trial using the managed channel-derived outbound path.

adapters.guidance: Preserve exact per-person configured role and Agent use authority alongside first-deployment preparation and upstream assigning-session protection. Administration alone must not grant runtime use.

Aggregate Slack and Teams gateway/control-plane requirements through the generic revision-owned managed proxy. Retain native media URL, redirect, token and TLS guards. Do not restore the retired shared Slack proxy, legacy proxy URLs or installation-wide Teams host lists. User proxy/trust-marker overrides are reserved; dedicated Harnesses receive neither Gateway credentials nor its trust marker.

Support both Slack and Teams in embedded and dedicated modes. Embedded trial defaults off, uses runtime.channels.experimentalEmbeddedChannels, requires managed outbound and only channel-derived destinations. Additional approved hosts remain dedicated-only. Preserve callback exact owner/revision/UID/resourceVersion fencing, serving annotation authority, provider cutovers and full cleanup.

Render trusted embedded opt-in only in the existing nested runtime.channels.experimentalEmbeddedChannels. Retain paired API/worker checksums and shared-credentials warning; opt-in requires enabled managed outbound.

report.summary: Profiles remains useful against frozen upstream 8e20e2019: its custom profile input, explicit seeding control, and readable custom starter are not absorbed. Retain the feature with upstream safeguards and fix the profile-file cleanup defect. No intent decision or mandatory source dependency was identified. No files or remote state were changed.
evidence: At 5acf92b89, scripts/render-installation-profile.mjs adds --profile-file, validates the supported PluginDriver selection, and forwards presets.includeDefaults. Frozen upstream still reads bundled profiles only and hardcodes includeDefaults: true.

At 5acf92b89, apps/controller/src/console/agents/presets.mts:551 selects readable default-codex first, otherwise the first readable Preset by sorted name. Upstream's corresponding code at lines 633–634 disables the shortcut without default-codex; manual custom-Preset selection is not equivalent.

Existing upstream infrastructure already supports startup seeding selection and custom-file overrides in apps/controller/src/composition/installation-presets.ts:115–183. The feature exposes this through the renderer; it does not require a replacement persistence implementation.

Generic source defect: scripts/render-installation-profile.mjs:2353 removes generated outputs before reading profileFile at line 2356. A trusted profile stored at <out-dir>/preflight.json, directly or through a symlink alias, is deleted before loading. Upstream commit 2d6bc00b6 protects --input using file identity before cleanup, but does not know about the feature's new profileFile input.

Upstream improvements to retain: 7379613f5 raises renderer Gateway memory requests/limits to 2560Mi/4Gi; b68e3b556, e8beeb3e7 and e94167c14 add Preset Secret operate/create restrictions; 0a17e7549 improves permission guidance. These affect the same renderer and Preset UI owners.

Supported feature proof includes tests/integration/profile-renderer.test.mjs for explicit profiles, rejected inputs, startup Preset selection and controller checksums; tests/browser/console-agent-presets.test.ts:3623 for readable/absent/denied defaults and custom-starter Agent creation; and tests/integration/postgres-preset-upgrade.test.mjs for persisted operator state across restarts. Cross-revision upgrade proof requires OCC_TEST_PRESET_BEFORE_ROOT and the separate migrator URL; the default test restarts the same revision.

Composition evidence: outbound a50b14647 replaces renderer channels inputs with gatewayOutbound/controlPlaneOutbound; embedded 94346f810 adds experimentalEmbeddedChannels under the older channels shape. Profiles independently changes PluginDriver selection and Preset seeding. These overlaps require composition adaptation, not source restacking.

Local verification at 5acf92b89: CI suite registration audit passed with no issues; three Node syntax checks and git diff --check passed. Kubernetes client, pg and Playwright dependencies are unavailable, so behavioral suites were not run locally.

Hosted CI associated with the frozen feature head is incomplete: run 40105418494 was cancelled, including Checks and Conformance 1 job 120906067347, Console Browser 2 job 120906067439, and PostgreSQL Platform job 120906067478. CI Required failed its cancellation check. This does not establish a product failure or passing feature coverage.
suggestions: Generic refresh fix: retain upstream sameProfileFile protection for --input and extend the pre-cleanup guard to the resolved profile file. Extend the existing input-collision regression in tests/integration/profile-renderer.test.mjs to cover profile-file direct paths and aliases, asserting that inputs and sibling outputs remain unchanged.
Apply the custom-starter changes narrowly over upstream Preset UI code, preserving Secret permission checks and refusal guidance. Keep upstream Gateway resource defaults and regression coverage.

Combination adaptation: preserve custom PluginDriver selection, hosted-discovery diagnostics and presets.includeDefaults while composing outbound and embedded renderer settings. Keep provider deployment prerequisites at runtime admission; this feature requires no Configuration-save validation changes.
Keep profiles independently applicable; no dependency or order changes are required. This feature adds no migration SQL or journal changes.

Complete renderer, browser and PostgreSQL coverage on the eventual candidate in configured CI. Obtain explicit cross-revision upgrade proof where required; cancelled jobs and same-revision restarts do not supply it.
